scope: Existing reader/reductions, fixed software truth. Target is scorer-only. No native or SOTA claim.

decision.scope: fixed finite-population decision; no physical calibration, default promotion or SOTA claim
decision.next: Only a flat pass permits the fixed textured comparison; shifted geometry and colour identity remain separate required controls.

failure_modes.variance: can reward blur or bias; paired ideal errors are required
failure_modes.mse: can reward smoothing; textured complex-wave errors and extremes remain required
failure_modes.amplitude: can reward wrong phase or overshoot; use complex coefficient error
failure_modes.uncertainty: descriptive fixed-seed sampling limits; never excuses a measured increase

work.tracked_scope: unique live backing ndarrays; not process RSS
